_note: Recorded generate result for a Novita (OpenAI-compatible) call (e.g. meta-llama/llama-3.1-70b-instruct). @ai-sdk/openai-compatible maps Novita's { prompt_tokens, completion_tokens } onto the high-level ai@7 LanguageModelUsage shape. This model reports no reasoning split, so normalizeUsage.reasoning must be 0 (a number, never null).
